pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā channo anācāraṃ ācarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.7: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā channo bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vakkhati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.10: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.11: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ channa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.12: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.15: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhū sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vakkhasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.16: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.17: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.18: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.19.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadeyya na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.20: sikkhamānena bhikkhave bhikkhunā aññātabbaṃ paripucchitabbaṃ paripañhitabbaṃ. ayaṃ tattha sāmīcīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.1.8: yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ etaṃ sahadhammikaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.1.9: tena vuccamāno evaṃ vadeti na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paṇḍitaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmīti bhaṇati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī evaṃ vadeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.2: upasampanne vematiko evaṃ vadeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī evaṃ vadeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.5: idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhūtattāya na pāsādikatāya na apacayāya na viriyārambhāya saṃvattatīti evaṃ vadeti na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paṇḍitaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmīti bhaṇati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.6: anupasampannena paññattena vā appaññattena vā vuccamāno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.7: idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhūtattāya na pāsādikatāya na apacayāya na viriyārambhāya saṃvattatīti evaṃ vadeti na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva naññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paṇḍitaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmīti bhaṇati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.16: idaṃ bhante kathaṃ imassa ko atthoti.
